# AgentWorld fixture files

`v1.3_benchmark/task_02_arrow_production.yaml`, `task_02_success_criteria.py` and
`verifier_utils.py` are copied unmodified from AgentWorld
(https://github.com/openagents-org/agentworld, commit 681b0e66,
`data_v0.1_multi/v1.3_benchmark/`). They are covered by the Mozilla Public
License 2.0 (`LICENSE.MPL-2.0`), not by this repository's MIT licence. They are
test fixtures only: the harness loads verifiers from the pinned AgentWorld
checkout at run time.
